items.text: In motorsport, Elfyn Evans and Scott Martin win the World Rally Championship.
A snap election is announced following widespread housing protests in Spain.
In rugby league, the Super League Grand Final ends with Wakefield Trinity defeating the Warrington Wolves.
High school students in France and Belgium launch mass protests for better conditions, starting fires and causing 400 schools to be closed.
